basic_info.description: This Charming 1900's cottage, located in an up and coming location near the T line and freeway is a real delight. A lovely updated home with an open floor plan that is perfect for relaxed daily living or casual entertaining. The 2 bedrooms have southern views that overlook a lovely back garden and deck to enjoy the sunny neighborhood. There is a downstairs bonus room (unwarranted) opening onto a large basement. The washer and dryer is in the basement and the rest of the space is ready for whatever the new owner creates.
